blurb: Unicorn Stables offers structured, coach-led horseback riding lessons for all ages and skill levels, from beginners to advanced riders. Lessons include grooming, tacking up, and horsemanship as part of the experience. They also offer riding camps and horse leasing programs to deepen rider engagement.
extraNote: Lessons happen rain or shine, indoors and outdoors; cancellations notified in advance · Riding camps have limited spots and fill up fast; contact office for availability
